title: Essay collocations
titleVi: Cụm từ cố định dùng trong bài luận
description: Bộ cụm động từ + danh từ và tính từ + danh từ mà giám khảo coi là dấu hiệu của band 7.5 trở lên. Học theo cụm giúp bạn tránh ghép sai từ và tăng tốc độ viết.
ieltsUse: Dùng trực tiếp trong Task 2 ở phần mở bài, thân bài và kết luận; nhiều cụm cũng dùng được cho Task 1 khi mô tả tác động của một xu hướng.

words.def: to create a danger to something
words.example: Automation may pose a threat to routine jobs in manufacturing and administration.
collocations: pose a threat to public health

words.def: to be the most important factor in a process
words.example: Parents play a pivotal role in shaping their children's attitudes to learning.

words.def: a matter that causes serious worry
words.example: The decline in youth mental health is a matter of grave concern.

words.def: to take action to deal with a problem
words.example: Policymakers have been slow to address an issue that affects millions of renters.

words.def: to make a difficult load easier to bear
words.example: Subsidised childcare would alleviate the burden on working parents.

words.def: to make people better informed about an issue
words.example: Campaigns that raise awareness of recycling have changed household habits.

words.def: to put an official plan into practice
words.example: The city was slow to implement a policy on low-emission zones.

words.def: to distribute money or staff for particular purposes
words.example: Governments should allocate resources to preventive healthcare rather than to hospitals.

words.def: to pay for something, often unwillingly
words.example: Taxpayers ultimately bear the cost of cleaning up polluted rivers.

words.def: to gain the advantages of something after effort
words.example: Countries that invest early in education reap the benefits for generations.

words.def: to obtain a deeper understanding of something
words.example: Longitudinal data allows researchers to gain insight into how habits form.

words.def: to arrive at general agreement among a group
words.example: Delegates failed to reach a consensus on binding emission targets.

words.vi: phân biệt rõ giữa hai thứ
words.def: to point out a meaningful difference between two things
words.example: It is important to draw a distinction between correlation and causation.

words.def: a harmful influence on something
words.example: Excessive screen time has a detrimental effect on children's sleep.

words.def: to use power to affect how something develops
words.example: Advertising can exert influence over the spending habits of young consumers.

words.def: to supply as much as people want
words.example: The new hospital was built to meet a demand for emergency care.

words.def: to be treated as more important than something else
words.example: In most budgets, short-term relief will take precedence over long-term investment.

words.def: to cause a public discussion to begin
words.example: The proposal to ban private cars is likely to spark debate across the city.

words.def: to experience expenses as a result of an action
words.example: Households that delay maintenance often incur costs far higher later on.

words.def: to make the effect of something less severe
words.example: Coastal defences can mitigate the impact of rising sea levels only to a point.

words.def: an increasing amount of research supporting a view
words.example: A growing body of evidence links air pollution to cognitive decline.
collocations: a growing body of evidence suggests

words.def: a problem that requires urgent attention
words.example: Youth unemployment remains a pressing issue in many southern provinces.

words.def: a solution that can realistically work
words.example: Congestion charging is a viable solution where public transport already exists.

words.def: a very great effect on something
words.example: The arrival of the internet had a profound impact on rural businesses.

words.def: to find a sensible middle point between two needs
words.example: Schools must strike a balance between academic rigour and creative freedom.
